title: digitalis mauretanica
intro: Digitalis mauretanica, commonly known as North African foxglove, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, treating congestive heart failure, and acting as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Digitalis mauretanica are primarily due to its cardiotonic properties, which help to increase the strength of the heart and improve its pumping efficiency. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardiac glycosides, such as digoxin and digitoxin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
